hypotheses.physical_signature: Normalized coincidence S = norm(Band5) × norm(Band19) filtered to 0.2km < Band15 < 1.2km depth window (shallow pediment/relay-ramp margins, avoiding deep basin centers and exposed bedrock), modulated by ReLU(geod_dilaterate) to favor actively extending crust. Ridge extraction via non-maximum suppression along Band5/Band19 gradient azimuths, then multi-scale (3px,6px) cross-strike curvature sign test to suppress compact volcanic plugs (which show high radial curvature) vs fault steps (low along-strike curvature). Output is a continuous [0,1] evidence surface thresholded via Poisson-disc sampling at 2.8px spacing to 37654 dots.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: USGS QFaults/INGENIOUS compilation relies on aerial-photo scarps and 10-30m DEM range-front mapping — systematically missing low-throw (0.3-1.5m) piedmont/relay-ramp scarplets buried by Quaternary alluvium. These manifest as weak Band19 slope lineaments (detected only at 100m as 2-5° breaks) coinciding with Band5 gravity steps from 0.3-1.2km basement offset, but individually below photogeologic mapping thresholds. The catalogue favors high-relief (>50m) range fronts; this lane targets low-relief concordant pairs at basin margins.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shoreline terraces (~1205m, ~1330m) and fluvial terrace risers produce coincident topographic + density steps without active dilatation; gated out via dilatation + detrended elevation window. Tertiary volcanic flow margins produce Band5 but lack Band19 slope concordance.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: No prior GEMSDOE86 lane combined Band5 × Band19 coincidence: H86N-GSST used Band5/11/13/18 gravity-only morphology (no topography); H86K-PSC used Hessian saddle-ridge topology on Bands 12/13; H86M-BMGS used BMR gravity residual vs RTP magnetics; GDSC used dilatation alone; FVMB used tri-regime thresholds. This is first depth-gated topographic-gravity concordance with dilatation modulation and curvature shape test.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Medium; suppresses deep-basin and high-range false positives; paired holdout vs Band5-alone and Band19-alone controls tests the concordance hypothesis. No score projection.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (O(N) Gaussian/gradient operators, no ML fitting; ~5 min CPU)
hypotheses.falsifier: Paired 95% block-bootstrap HOLDOUT-DTI difference vs Band5-alone (E1) and Band19-alone (E2) and depth-uniform (E3) controls fails to exclude zero — or single-feature leakage AUC >0.90.

hypotheses.name: Magnetite-Destruction Conductance Tube — band-pass RTP trough bounded by conductance walls in dilatant corridors
hypotheses.physical_signature: Band-pass (sigma 12px - sigma 30px) negative RTP residual isolating 1-2km hydrothermal demagnetization troughs from regional pluton fields, required to be flanked within ±4px by steep Band17 conductance gradients (|grad cond|) under positive Band8 dilatation. Cross-strike profile extracts trough-to-wall amplitude ratio.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Active blind geothermal conduits along basin-interior fault damage zones alter magnetite to pyrite/clays (demag trough) and precipitate conductive smectite (wall), without surface scarp.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Non-magnetic felsic intrusives, caldera margins, saline playa brines
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H86I-RKSC used positive high-frequency magnetic gradients; no lane targeted negative band-pass trough + flanking walls
hypotheses.falsifier: Trough-wall score trails unsigned RTP gradient control

hypotheses.name: Conjugate Riedel-Shear Finsler Transport — geodetic strain-rate anisotropic shortest-path relay breaching
hypotheses.physical_signature: Derives local principal strain axes from geodetic invariants (Bands 4,7,8) to build orthorhombic Finsler metric favoring Riedel R/R' (±(45°-φ/2), φ=30°) and tension fractures; solves anisotropic eikonal for minimum-energy geodesic corridors bridging high-curvature Band5 terminations across accommodation zones.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Strain transfer between NNE Basin-Range normals and NW Walker Lane dextral faults via conjugate meshes lacks single-scarp continuity
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Conjugate jointing in welded tuffs without throw
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H86I-KSAD evaluated pointwise Kostrov tendency at fixed azimuth; this solves non-local Finsler paths on spatially varying axes
hypotheses.falsifier: Geodesic corridor fails to beat isotropic gravity-slope control

hypotheses.name: LiDAR Micro-Scarp Persistence — watershed-crossing 1-m 3DEP curvature continuity
hypotheses.external_source: Official free USGS 3DEP 1-m LidarExplorer (https://apps.nationalmap.gov/lidar-explorer/), free public-domain, obtainable on unrestricted workstation; NOT in sandbox due to egress allowlist. Mirror must be pinned before execution.
hypotheses.physical_signature: Signed 5-25m cross-strike profile curvature steps on native 1-m DEMs retaining polarity across >=3 drainage divides, vetoing channels/shorelines/roads.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: 0.3-1.5m piedmont scarps smoothed below noise in 30-100m DEMs, invisible in pre-LiDAR airphotos, persist at 1-m
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Lake Lahontan benches, terrace risers, highway grades
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Zero lanes ingest native 1-m tiles; prior used quantized 100m summary bands only
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Medium-high if data obtained; high cost
hypotheses.falsifier: Native relocation shows no displacement-conditioned gain over random 2px SNAP control

hypotheses.external_source: Official free NASA/JPL OPERA L3 DISP-S1 via ASF DAAC (https://asf.alaska.edu/datasets/daac/opera/), free public-domain; NOT in sandbox (egress allowlist). Requires workstation download + EPSG:32611 warp.
hypotheses.physical_signature: 30-m InSAR LOS velocity steps and seasonal aquitard-head phase jumps marking fault-core hydraulic compartmentalization, validated against sparse GPS invariants.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Bands 4/7/8 are 15-30km smoothed GPS grids incapable of resolving 100-m fault-core hydrology
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Stratigraphic clay pinch-outs, agricultural pumping, mine dewatering
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: No lane ingests 30-m InSAR; native strain grids are 100x coarser
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: High if data obtained; currently impossible in sandbox
hypotheses.falsifier: InSAR steps correlate with stratigraphy not fault traces
